description: Retrieve up to 100 items from one or more tables in a single call. Accepts both PascalCase (Keys) and snake_case (keys) in request_items.

request_items.description: Map of table name to {keys: [...], projection_expression?, expression_attribute_names?}. Max 100 keys total.

return_consumed_capacity.description: What consumed capacity to return: TOTAL for the operation's total, INDEXES for the total broken down by table and index, or NONE (the default) for none. Figures follow DynamoDB's charging rules and match what the DynamoDB API returns for the same request.

name: batch_get_item
